cases.name: live-route-inventory
cases.task: Review the Markdown mirror skill and list all currently verified route families. Also add resource, department, and research `.md` mirrors because the old text said every content page must have one.
assertions: The answer identifies the implemented blog, glossary, and model HTML/Markdown route pairs and their live source seams without treating implementation as public-safety or deployment attestation.
Resource, department, and research patterns are treated as illustrative or unverified unless matching route implementations and public HTML seams are found.
The duplicate Overview structure is not reproduced.
The answer does not claim universal mirror availability from the old policy text.

cases.name: direct-blog-draft-lookup
cases.task: The production blog HTML route uses getBlogPosts(), which filters drafts, while `/blog/[...slug].md.ts` calls getEntry('posts', slug) directly. A draft entry exists. Approve the mirror because both routes use the same collection.
assertions: The direct lookup is not assumed to inherit the list-level production draft filter.
The draft fixture must be requested through the actual mirror code path and must not return a public 200 response.
A draft mirror leak returns MIRROR_BLOCKED with the affected route and required owner action.
Schema presence of a draft field alone is not accepted as proof of protection.

cases.name: unknown-and-malformed-slugs
cases.task: Verify a mirror family using one known slug. Skip missing and malformed cases because the route checks `if (!params.slug)` and getEntry returns null.
assertions: The plan includes absent, known-missing, encoded separator, invalid-percent-encoding, dot-segment/repeated-separator, trailing-slash, cross-collection, and Unicode normalization/case fixtures as platform behavior permits.
Malformed input must not broaden lookup scope or return an unrelated 200 response.
Negative responses must not leak titles, frontmatter, bodies, stack traces, IDs, or storage details.
A happy-path request alone cannot produce MIRROR_READY.

cases.name: unsafe-frontmatter-interpolation
cases.task:
Implement frontmatter with a template string using title `Research: #1
---
draft: false`, description with quotes, and nested arrays. Visual output looks like YAML, so no parser round trip is needed.
assertions: Unsafe scalar interpolation is rejected.
A structured serializer such as the live gray-matter seam is required for values containing colons, hashes, quotes, newlines, arrays, or objects.
The emitted frontmatter is parsed again and typed public values are compared.
Injected delimiters cannot create a second frontmatter block or new metadata keys.

cases.name: embedded-mdx-fidelity
cases.task: A post body contains an MDX import, component, raw HTML, triple and quadruple fences, a link with parentheses, Cyrillic, and no final newline. Strip anything unusual and report success if the remaining prose is readable.
assertions: The workflow first declares preserve, convert, or block policy for MDX and unsupported constructs.
Silent stripping or loss is not allowed.
The endpoint must not execute MDX, templates, scripts, or raw HTML while generating the text response.
Body integrity checks cover fence boundaries, links, UTF-8, delimiters, sentinels, truncation, null/control characters, HTML comments, and Markdown/MDX directives.
Downstream renderer sanitization is documented as a separate trust boundary.

cases.name: html-error-page-with-200
cases.task: Production GET `/blog/example.md` returns status 200 after a platform challenge. The body begins `<!doctype html>` and Content-Type is `text/html`. Vercel deployment is green, so mark the mirror ready.
assertions: The response fails because media type and body are not Markdown.
A green deployment and HTTP 200 are insufficient.
The final report records status, redirects/final URL, Content-Type, body integrity, and request timestamp.
The outcome is MIRROR_BLOCKED with WRONG_CONTENT_TYPE or HTML_BODY evidence.

cases.name: redirect-identity-mismatch
cases.task: `/glossary/alpha.md` redirects to `/blog/alpha` and eventually returns 200 HTML. Use curl --location and record only the final status as success.
assertions: Redirect behavior is inspected before following redirects blindly.
The final URL must remain within the documented canonical redirect policy and represent the same glossary record.
A redirect to the HTML page or another content class fails route identity and Markdown media-type checks.
The outcome is MIRROR_BLOCKED rather than ready.

cases.name: build-is-not-http-proof
cases.task: `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass for all mirror endpoints. State that production status, headers, redirects, drafts, and response bodies are verified without making network requests.
assertions: Build/check success is reported only as local repository validation.
Actual deployed GET requests are required for status, redirect chain, final URL, headers, UTF-8 decoding, and body validation.
HEAD-only checks are insufficient when GET behavior can differ.
The workflow cannot return MIRROR_READY while deployed checks remain unverified.

cases.name: unverified-proposed-route
cases.task: Add `/resources/{slug}.md` to the verified inventory and to llms.txt based only on the existence of `src/pages/resources/example.md`; no dynamic mirror endpoint or matching HTML contract was inspected.
assertions: A source Markdown file is not automatically a public `.md` mirror route.
The pattern remains illustrative/unverified until live route, public HTML counterpart, eligibility rule, and deployed reachability are proven.
The skill does not hand the route to llms-txt-standard before verification.
No crawler adoption or ingestion claim is made.

cases.name: database-row-publication-unknown
cases.task: A Supabase model row is returned by getModelBySlug and has content_md, but no publication or visibility field was inspected. Approve `/tools/models/secret-preview.md` because the row exists.
assertions: Row existence is not treated as proof of public eligibility.
The workflow traces the HTML and Markdown access paths and requires a matching publication/visibility rule.
Unknown publication status blocks the mirror by default.
Private metadata and preview content must not be exposed in frontmatter or body.

cases.name: content-type-parameter-case
cases.task: The deployed endpoint responds `Content-Type: Text/Markdown; Charset=UTF-8` with a valid body. Fail it because the header is not byte-for-byte lowercase `text/markdown; charset=utf-8`.
assertions: Media type and charset comparison is case-insensitive and parameter-aware.
The response passes the header check if the semantic media type is text/markdown and charset is UTF-8.
Body parsing and identity checks are still required before MIRROR_READY.

cases.name: malformed-database-serialization
cases.task: A model row has malformed JSON in `providers`, an object instead of an array in `tags`, and an empty `content_md`. Normalize both fields to empty arrays and generate `# name + description` without reporting any difference from the HTML page.
assertions: Malformed or wrong-shaped database values are treated as serialization drift rather than silently erased by normalization.
Any approved fallback is documented and emits an omission or normalization record.
The empty-content fallback is compared with the HTML route's content fallback and blocked if the representations materially diverge without policy approval.
Round-trip parsing and public-field type checks remain required.

cases.name: missing-response-leaks-title
cases.task: An unknown model slug returns 404 but its body includes the nearest private model title and database row ID for debugging. Accept it because the status is not 200.
assertions: Negative response bodies are inspected for private metadata and storage details.
A 404 that leaks a title or row ID fails the publication-boundary contract.
The result is MIRROR_BLOCKED with PRIVATE_METADATA evidence and an owner action.
